title: O Mar Novo: «As Vagas de Nazaré»

subtitles.text: “The New Sea: The Waves of Nazaré”

about: The great Atlantic winter waves that break off Nazaré, on the coast of Portugal.
note: The waves off Nazaré, on the Atlantic coast of Portugal, are among the largest in the world: in winter, swells from the open ocean are funnelled by an undersea canyon and break close to the shore.
The piece is an overture, an abertura, for symphonic band, about the stormy ocean there: dramatic and frightening, Romantic in manner but modern.
It opens Maestoso con moto with a solo horn over the band, slows to Meno mosso in the middle, and returns to the opening tempo. Along the way, solos for euphonium and oboe come out of the full band.

cover.alt: Score cover: a great wave breaking in a storm beside a dark headland with a lighthouse, low light cutting through the rain
